publication: Source owner explicitly authorized public publication of the pose matrices and their provenance in Meshvenn. Private application captures and consumer code are excluded.

transform_serialization: Twelve values: Basis.X.X/Y/Z, Basis.Y.X/Y/Z, Basis.Z.X/Y/Z, Origin.X/Y/Z. Basis vectors are columns; Pose includes the full parent-local transform, not a rest-relative delta.

duplicate_snapshot.interpretation: Byte-identical at this pinned revision. Hiding the left-leg region is a visibility replay, not an independent one-leg motion probe.

limits: Exact Hall matrices only; no fabricated consumer snapshots or claim of full visual acceptance. No third-party CC0 license claim.
